links.outcome: Concordance between model salient features and manually identified race/ethnicity text spans
links.effect: Models performed well on the surface, but the audit found concerning learned associations and potential for future harms. No numbers reported in the abstract.
links.quote: We show that while models perform well on the surface, there exist concerning learned associations and potential for future harms from RE-identification models if left unaddressed.

unlisted_practices: Auditing model learned associations by measuring concordance between salient features and manually annotated race/ethnicity spans

screen.reason: Empirical study auditing safety/bias and feature attribution concordance in deep learning/NLP models extracting race and ethnicity from clinical text.
